sql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(o.quantity_product * p.price), 0) AS revenue_cents FROM orders o JOIN product p ON p.product_id = o.product_id JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE o.date >= '2026-01-01 00:00:00' AND o.date < '2026-07-01 00:00:00' AND o.product_id IN ('a', 'b', 'c');

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(o.quantity_product * p.price), 0) AS revenue_cents FROM orders o JOIN product p ON p.product_id = o.product_id JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE (CAST(strftime('%Y', date(o.date)) AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', c.birth_date) AS INTEGER) - (strftime('%m-%d', date(o.date)) < strftime('%m-%d', c.birth_date))) = 25;
